## 主张 Claim

保留接合并提升固定单位置接合的映射保留全部关联问题；两个这样的共同细化投影有唯一通向同测片段对的函数，同时保留接合并与两个投影相容。 / A join-preserving map lifting joins at one fixed participant preserves all incidence questions; two such common-refinement projections have a unique join-preserving function to the equally answering pairs commuting with both projections.

Canonical source: [ExplanatoryJoiningRefinement.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/ExplanatoryJoiningRefinement.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 同一 L 的两映射 p:L→J、q:L→K 分别满足明示 OpenMap。 / Two maps p:L→J and q:L→K from the same L satisfy the explicit OpenMap condition.

OpenMap 的强提升条件是给定解释条件；共同细化的投影在前一成果中另有导出。 / The strong OpenMap lifting condition is supplied for a given interpretation; the preceding result derives it for the canonical projections.

The new core module Becoming.Joining, importing only Becoming.Likeness, reads a joining of fragments as frames of the spine, through partners, roles and retained references; a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame, with no premise (Joining.lifts_iff); Becoming.JoiningBridge reads the joining studies as instances. Open maps of joinings are the open maps of the role frames (Joining.openMap_iff; in the bridge openMap_iff_incidence) and keep likeness and every role test (OpenMap.alike, Joining.OpenMap.sameBranchingTests, openMap_keeps_role_tests); two open maps from one joining factor through it, the factor unique at every fragment (Joining.universal_factor). It differs from the periphery: uniqueness is pointwise, since equality of functions needs funext, and the factor maps into alike pairs rather than equally answering ones. The periphery's incidence step, sameness of answers and span are defined through a match with an overlapping wildcard case (the register study's step through xs[i]?), and their compiled definitions use propext, so no statement mentioning them has an empty axiom report; the claim is therefore restated on the core's role frame (Joining.roleFrame) or retained frame (Joining.retainedFrame), not as a literal instance, the bridge showing that the periphery's open maps and local finiteness are the core's (openMap_iff_incidence, locallyFinite_iff). The periphery's every_exact_account_has_canonical_factor needs funext and propext and stays there. Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing).
